title: Verify Vieta's formulas for the general cubic

problemStatement.plain: Vieta's formulas for x³ + ax² + bx + c = (x-r₁)(x-r₂)(x-r₃) over any CommRing.
whyMatters: Extends depressed cubic Vieta's to general case
